Record revision: `2026-09-17-i2-closed-v1`.

- **2026-09-17 / I2-OOC-POSTROUTE** — Real-AMU I2 U50 OOC closes at 156.25 MHz after structural state/margin pipelining: synth WNS +2.318 ns, routed WNS +1.078 ns, TNS 0, 3396 LUT, 2383 FF, 19 RAMB36 + 1 RAMB18, 10 DSP, and zero routing errors.
- **2026-09-17 / I2-OOC-HARNESS-READY** — Real-AMU I2 OOC Vivado flow, packaging and CI compile-smoke are prepared and passing.
- **2026-09-17 / I2-COMMITTED-EXECUTION** — Committed execution reconciliation regression passes partial fill, stale/duplicate fail-closed, replay-once, fill-plus-terminal-release, cancel, reduce and R03 release-once scenarios with exact order-context lifecycle updates.
- **2026-09-17 / I2-ORDER-CONTEXT** — A 96-bit futures order context keyed by order_id reuses the frozen RMIC AMU contract for account/product/side/PositionEffect/OrdType/TIF/limit-price/remaining-qty ownership without reusing stock-like account accounting.
- **2026-09-17 / I2-STATE-MANAGER-FUNCTIONAL** — Multi-account/product futures state manager regression passed key isolation, short open, long close, margin reject, fail-closed ownership, config priority and reset-recovery cases. Initial CI timeout was a testbench handshake race and is preserved in the I2 plan.
- **2026-09-17 / I2-GOVERNANCE** — LOB-inspired phase governance adopted: canonical project state, append-only decisions, living ExecPlan, one phase branch/PR, evidence-layer boundaries and mechanical governance CI.
- **2026-09-17 / I1-EXEC-META-TAP** — Integration-owned R02/R32 fixed-offset tap captures PositionEffect and before_qty fields missing from the frozen HFT decoder; mutation authority remains external committed-report ownership.
- **2026-09-17 / I1-FUTURES-ACCOUNTING** — Futures accounting v1 separates long/short and OPEN/CLOSE semantics using a host-configured margin-per-contract research model; not a TAIFEX SPAN claim.
